capabilities: Open saved or temporary websites in tabs, floating windows, or embedded frames in notes
Save passkey profiles with URLs and credentials and auto-fill login forms by scanning the page DOM
Embed websites in notes with fenced emb blocks
Insert gate links that open configured sites through the plugin
Generate site icons from favicon sources with a monogram fallback
disambiguation: Its 'passkey' profiles are just saved URL and credential entries for auto sign-in, not WebAuthn passkeys or a password manager.
extras: README warns that stored credentials are unencrypted in the vault's plugin settings and that Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, and Google account login may not work in the embedded webview; private Google files should use 'Publish to web' URLs or an external browser.
problem: Obsidian's built-in web viewing only opens pages; there is no way to save sites with sign-in details, embed them in notes, or keep web apps visible while working.
summary: In-app web browser that opens sites in tabs, floating windows, or note embeds, and can auto-fill saved login credentials.
